summary: FAZ B1 Task Reassignment (Devret) on mobile validated end-to-end. Happy path: temp task -> Devret modal -> search 'ahmet' -> pick user -> modal closes -> SAHİP section now shows 'ahmet' (owner changed as expected). Modal UX: non-match shows 'Kullanıcı bulunamadı', empty query hides it, close (X) works. Regression on task detail passes: status toggle, subtask add/toggle/delete, reminder chip (3 gün), edit modal open/cancel. Temp task cleaned up via delete. Only known non-blocking warning: react-native-web 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' (pre-existing, mentioned by main agent).
critical_code_review_comments: task/[id].tsx openReassign correctly resets query/results/error state and detail Reload happens implicitly by setTask(updated) returned from POST /tasks/{id}/reassign - clean.
Debounced search filters out the current owner (u.id !== task?.user_id) which prevents self-reassignment noise - good UX.

No error-path exercised end-to-end for 423 (locked task) since serkan bypasses locks; backend already verified via curl per handoff. Non-admin locked-task UI path was not testable with the provided serkan credential.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 checks in mobile detail reassign + regression)

test_credentials: serkan / 19071987 (admin, bypasses locks). Reassign target 'ahmet' confirmed present via /api/users/search.
seed_data_creation: Created a temp task 'TMP-REASSIGN-<epoch>' and deleted it at the end of the run - no residual data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright quirk: task-form-save-button may report 'Element is outside of the viewport' on Expo web preview at 390x844; using height=1200 plus a dispatch_event('click') fallback wrapper made the click reliable. Poll for [data-testid^='task-detail-reassign-user-'] up to ~8s because /api/users/search can be slower than the 300ms debounce. On a freshly-created single-owner task by serkan the SAHİP section shows '—' initially (no assignee_name until reassignment / assignees populated); this is by design, not a bug.
